fix(fedora-sway): fix two bugs preventing FCOS automated rebase

Bug 1: rpm-ostree rebase used invalid --bypass-driver flag, causing the
rebase-to-sway.service to fail immediately. Fixed by removing the invalid
flag; keeping </dev/null to suppress any interactive prompts.

Bug 2: NetworkManager connection used interface-name=eth0, but Proxmox
virtio NICs use predictable names (ens3, enp6s18, etc.) on FCOS. Fixed
by removing the interface-name constraint so NM matches any ethernet NIC.

Also: rename NM profile to static.nmconnection and drop graphical.target
from setup-user-env.service ordering (network-online.target is sufficient).
